title: Church choir and teaching himself piano around age 12
summary: His father sang in the church choir; Crawford taught himself piano with friends, not learning from anyone in particular.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No. Well, my father sung in the choir at church. And I did too for a while. Well, in fact I still do. But he never played music for a living.
How old were you when you started playing piano?
I was about 12 years old, I guess.
What, you just listened to the radio and sort of picked it up? No, no.

No, I just, you know, it wasn't really, I don't know, nobody really taught me. I was just fooling around and had a couple of friends at pianos. We used to go to each other's houses and we just bang on the piano. So I just picked it up from that.
Were you listening to somebody special like Roy Brown or did you like Jim Turner or something? No.
Well, no, not, I liked them all, but I didn't really learn anything from them. I just, I just, I just, I just liked music.
